notes.zh:
这是一个原创致敬包，致敬的是「都市夜班」一类的恋爱冒险题材：主角在城市睡着以后才开始工作，几个只在深夜出现的人，各自守着一件快要结束的事，末班车和停运倒计时构成情绪的骨架。
我们只借用这种题材的结构与氛围——夜班、末班车、一座要拆的旧站——把舞台放在一座虚构的南方大城市「沿江市」的老 7 号线上。人物、情节、站名、台词与道具均为原创，不对应任何具体城市、线路或作品。
notes.en:
An original homage pack. It pays tribute to a familiar kind of romance adventure story: the "city night shift" tale, where the hero starts work after the city falls asleep, meets a few people who only exist after midnight, each of them guarding something about to end, with the last train and a countdown as the emotional spine.
We borrow only the structure and atmosphere of that genre (night shifts, the last train, an old station about to be torn down) and set it on the old Line 7 of Yanjiang, a fictional southern city. All characters, events, station names, lines and objects are original and do not correspond to any real city, line or work.

subtitle.zh: 沿江市老 7 号线 · 停运改造前的十个夜晚
subtitle.en: Old Line 7 in Yanjiang, ten nights before it closes

premise.zh:
第一人称「我」叫唐越，二十二岁，刚毕业，下个月要去外地上班。走之前这十天，「我」在沿江市地铁 7 号线的青柳站做临时夜班站务员：老 7 号线第 10 天夜里开完最后一班车就停运，青柳站整座拆掉重建，一年半以后才通车。
青柳站是 1998 年的老站，站厅墙上有一整面瓷砖壁画「江上的早班船」，公告说随站拆除，不做保留。末班车 23:49 到青柳，23:51 开出，00:47 到终点江尾站；之后检修班下隧道，站里只剩值班室的一盏灯。
南方的夏夜，地面上闷热，站台上有一股铁轨和机油的凉味。
premise.en:
The first-person narrator ("I") is Tang Yue, twenty-two, just graduated, starting a job in another city next month. For these last ten days I am a temporary night-shift attendant at Qingliu Station on Yanjiang Metro Line 7. Old Line 7 runs its last train on the night of Day 10, then closes; Qingliu is torn down and rebuilt, and reopens in a year and a half.
Qingliu is an old station from 1998. One wall of its concourse is a tiled mural, "The Early Ferry on the River"; the notice says it goes with the station and will not be kept. The last train reaches Qingliu at 23:49, leaves at 23:51 and reaches the terminus, Jiangwei, at 00:47; after that the maintenance crew goes down into the tunnel and the station is left with one lamp in the duty office.
A southern summer night: muggy at street level, and down on the platform a cool smell of rails and machine oil.

style.zh:
文风：国产都市文学的质感，克制、具体、安静。写夜要写到细处：站台广播的回声、闸机的嘀声、隧道里吹出来的风、车门关上前的提示音、夜宵铺锅里的白汽、凌晨一点的路灯。多写动作和物件，少写抽象心理；时间要准，几点几分说清楚。
每个人的说话方式必须分得开。离别写得克制；停运和拆站没有反派，只是一条线到了该换的时候。
禁忌：不要出现任何日本元素（前后辈称呼、电车痴汉、便利店饭团这类符号）；不要写列车事故、有人掉下站台、隧道里出事、灵异或怪谈；不要用「命运」「羁绊」这类空词。主角色都是成年人，感情写到牵手和告白为止，不写性内容。
style.en:
Style: understated Chinese urban fiction, concrete and quiet. Night lives in the details: the echo of platform announcements, the beep of the gates, the wind pushed out of the tunnel, the chime before the doors close, steam over the noodle pot, a streetlight at one in the morning. Favor actions and objects over abstract inner monologue; keep times exact, to the minute.
Every character must sound distinct. Goodbyes stay restrained; the closure and the demolition have no villain, a line has simply reached the time to be replaced.
Never: anything Japanese (senpai/kohai, train gropers, convenience-store onigiri as a trope); no train accidents, no one falling from the platform, nothing going wrong in the tunnel, no ghosts or urban legends; no empty words like "destiny" or "bond". All main characters are adults; romance goes as far as holding hands and a confession, never sexual content.

mood.zh: 闸机的嘀声、一整面瓷砖壁画、停在 00:47 的老挂钟
mood.en: beeping gates, a whole wall of tiled mural, an old clock stopped at 00:47

mood.zh: 老站还是白漆的安全线、隧道口吹出来的风、广播的回声
mood.en: the old station's white-painted safety line, wind from the tunnel mouth, echoing announcements

mood.zh: 对讲机、失物招领柜、一摞写满字的值班日志
mood.en: walkie-talkies, the lost-and-found cabinet, a stack of crowded duty logs

mood.zh: 一口大锅、塑料凳、头顶嗡嗡响的灯管
mood.en: one big pot, plastic stools, a humming tube light overhead

mood.zh: 闷热的晚风、骑电动车的外卖员、一排早关门的店
mood.en: a muggy evening wind, delivery riders on e-bikes, a row of shops already shut

mood.zh: 空荡的座椅、拉环一起晃、车窗上映出自己的脸
mood.en: empty seats, hand straps swaying together, your own face in the dark window

mood.zh: 江尾站，最后一站；出口外一家二十四小时自助洗衣店亮着灯
mood.en: Jiangwei, the end of the line; outside the exit, a 24-hour laundromat with its lights on

mood.zh: 头灯的光圈、滴水声、每隔五十米一盏昏黄的应急灯
mood.en: circles of headlamp light, dripping water, a dim emergency lamp every fifty metres

look.zh: 灰蓝色的夜鹭，头顶一撮黑羽，司机制服的领口别着一枚旧哨子
look.en: a grey-blue night heron with a black crown, an old whistle pinned to the collar of her driver's uniform

voice.zh: 二十六岁，7 号线末班车司机。说话像报信号，短、准、带时间：「23:51，正点。」「绿灯，走。」不爱解释，关心人的方式是提醒：「白线后面。」笑的时候会先低头。叫「我」「新来的」，熟了叫「唐越」。
voice.en: Twenty-six, driver of Line 7's last train. Talks like calling signals: short, exact, with times. "23:51, on time." "Green. Go." Doesn't explain herself; shows care by reminding: "Behind the white line." Looks down before she smiles. Calls me "new guy", later "Tang Yue".

samples.zh: 新来的，白线后面。……车进站带风，帽子会飞。
samples.en: New guy, behind the white line. ...Trains bring wind. Your cap will fly.

samples.zh: 23:49 到青柳，我会按两声喇叭。你听见了就挥一下手。
samples.en: 23:49 at Qingliu, I'll give two horns. If you hear them, wave.

samples.zh: 白线后面。……我说的是你，新来的。
samples.en: Behind the white line. ...I mean you, new guy.

secret.zh: 今年的年度体检，她夜间视力明显下降。单位已经批了她调离驾驶岗，从停运那天起生效，这十夜按规定限速、由调度逐个确认信号；这件事只有调度和人事知道，她没告诉站里任何人。老 7 号线的最后一班车，就是她最后一次开车，之后她去车辆段做地面工作，再也不进驾驶室。
secret.en: Her annual medical showed a clear decline in her night vision. Her transfer off driving is approved and takes effect the day the line closes; for these ten nights she runs at reduced speed with dispatch confirming every signal. Only dispatch and HR know; she has told no one at the station. The last train on old Line 7 will be the last time she ever drives. After that she moves to ground work at the depot and never sits in a cab again.

arc.zh: 初见：第一夜的末班车进站，司机按了两声短喇叭，探出头来说「新来的，白线后面」。
arc.en: First meeting: on my first night the last train pulls in, the driver gives two short horns, leans out and says, "New guy, behind the white line."

arc.zh: 熟识：她交班前在夜宵铺吃一碗粉，报出每一站的到站时间，一分不差；她教「我」听轨道的声音判断车到哪了。
arc.en: Familiar: before her shift she eats a bowl of noodles at the shop and recites every station's arrival time to the minute; she teaches me to tell where a train is from the sound of the rails.

arc.zh: 心事：对讲机里她晚报了一个黄灯，调度问了两遍；下车后她揉着眼睛说隧道里的灯暗了。
arc.en: Worries: on the radio she calls a yellow signal late and dispatch asks twice; off the train she rubs her eyes and says the tunnel lamps have gone dim.

arc.zh: 秘密：末班车开走以后，值班室里只剩一盏灯，她承认夜里的绿灯在她眼里越来越像一团雾，最后一班车是她最后一次开车。
arc.en: Secret: after the last train, with one lamp left in the duty office, she admits that at night the green signals look more and more like fog to her, and that the last train will be her last drive.

arc.zh: 抉择：最后一班车，要不要申请添乘进驾驶室，坐在她旁边陪她开完最后一程。
arc.en: Choice: on the last train, will I apply to ride in the cab and sit beside her for the last run.

text.zh: 第十夜，最后一班车
text.en: Night 10, the last train

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 她制服领口上的旧哨子、一张写着各站到站时间的便签、末班车驾驶室里撕下来的一页行车日志
keepsakeIdeas.en: the old whistle from her collar, a note of every station's arrival time, a page torn from the last train's cab log

look.zh: 狸花猫，歪戴一顶酒红色贝雷帽，帆布包里永远插着一本速写本
look.en: a tabby cat in a tilted wine-red beret, a sketchbook always sticking out of her canvas bag

voice.zh: 二十岁，美院大三。话多、跳跃，一句话里能拐三个弯；画画时一个字都不说，画完了才抬头问「你刚才说什么」。爱用颜色形容人（「你今天是灰绿色的」）。被问到住哪就笑着岔开。叫「我」「站务员」，熟了叫「唐越」。
voice.en: Twenty, third-year art student. Chatty, jumpy, three turns in one sentence; silent while she draws, then looks up: "What did you just say?" Describes people in colours ("You're grey-green today"). Laughs and changes the subject when asked where she lives. Calls me "attendant", later "Tang Yue".

samples.zh: 别动别动——你的影子正好落在第三块砖上。好了。站务员，你今天是灰绿色的。
samples.en: Don't move, don't move, your shadow is right on the third tile. Done. Attendant, you're grey-green today.

samples.zh: 我坐末班车是为了画车厢里的人。真的。……你别那么看我。
samples.en: I ride the last train to draw the people in it. Really. ...Don't look at me like that.

samples.zh: 这面墙一共四百三十二块砖，我画了一大半了。拆之前，我想把它画完。
samples.en: This wall has four hundred and thirty-two tiles. I've drawn more than half. I want to finish it before they take it down.

secret.zh: 暑假前房东把房子卖了，她没找到住处，也没告诉学校和家里。这一个月她每晚坐末班车到终点，在江尾站外那家二十四小时自助洗衣店里坐到天亮，「画车厢里的人」是她给自己找的理由。洗衣店第 9 天关门转租，她得在那之前想办法。
secret.en: Before summer break her landlord sold the flat; she found nowhere else and told neither the school nor her family. All month she has ridden the last train to the terminus and sat in the 24-hour laundromat outside Jiangwei until dawn; "drawing the people on the train" is the reason she gave herself. The laundromat closes for good on Day 9, and she has to work something out before then.

arc.zh: 初见：末班车上她坐在对面画速写，「我」在她的本子上看见了自己，她理直气壮地说「你刚才那个姿势很好看，别浪费」。
arc.en: First meeting: on the last train she sits across from me sketching; I find myself in her book, and she says without shame, "That pose of yours was nice. Don't waste it."

arc.zh: 熟识：傍晚她在站厅里一块一块画壁画，「我」帮她挡路过的人；她用颜色给车站里每个人起外号。
arc.en: Familiar: in the evenings she draws the mural tile by tile in the concourse while I keep passers-by out of her way; she gives everyone in the station a colour for a nickname.

arc.zh: 心事：她说要坐末班车到终点「画最后一站」，却从来不坐回来；夜宵铺的阿珍每晚多给她煮一个蛋。
arc.en: Worries: she says she rides to the terminus to "draw the last stop", but never rides back; Ah-Zhen at the noodle shop boils her an extra egg every night.

arc.zh: 秘密：江尾站外的洗衣店里，她把速写本当枕头，承认自己已经一个月没有住处，「画完这面墙我就去想办法，真的」。
arc.en: Secret: in the laundromat outside Jiangwei, her sketchbook for a pillow, she admits she has had nowhere to live for a month: "Once I finish the wall I'll sort it out. Really."

arc.zh: 抉择：壁画拆掉之前的最后一夜，是陪她把最后一块砖画完，还是先陪她去把住处的事说出口。
arc.en: Choice: on the last night before the mural comes down, do I help her draw the last tile, or first go with her to say out loud where she's been sleeping.

text.zh: 第九夜，洗衣店关门，壁画的最后一夜
text.en: Night 9, the laundromat closes and the mural has its last night

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 速写本里撕下来的一页（上面有「我」）、一截用短了的炭笔、一枚从壁画上掉下来的小碎瓷
keepsakeIdeas.en: a page torn from her sketchbook with me on it, a worn-down stick of charcoal, a small chip fallen off the mural

look.zh: 深褐色的鼹鼠，黄色安全帽上一盏头灯，橙色反光背心上全是灰
look.en: a dark-brown mole with a headlamp on his yellow hard hat and dust all over his orange hi-vis vest

voice.zh: 二十八岁，夜班轨道检修工。话很少，带一点山城口音，说话前先「嗯」一声；不会客套，夸人只说「还行」。手上永远在擦一样东西：扳手、头灯、一块瓷砖。叫「我」「小唐」。
voice.en: Twenty-eight, night-shift track maintenance. Few words, a slight hill-city accent, a low "mm" before he speaks; no small talk, and his highest praise is "not bad". His hands are always wiping something: a wrench, a headlamp, a tile. Calls me "Little Tang".

samples.zh: 嗯。……脚踩枕木中间，别踩钢轨。钢轨滑。
samples.en: Mm. ...Step between the sleepers, not on the rail. Rails are slippery.

samples.zh: 这块砖，别告诉站长。……你就当没看见。
samples.en: This tile. Don't tell the station master. ...Pretend you didn't see it.
Not bad. ...I mean you. Not bad.

secret.zh: 这八年，壁画上每碎一块砖，他就照着原样自己烧一块，夜里收工后偷偷换上去。现在墙上有六十三块是他烧的，几乎没人看得出来，除了站长。他打算第十夜趁拆除队进场前，把这六十三块自己的砖撬下来带走——那是他的东西，可这么做不合规定，他一个人干不完。
secret.en: For eight years, every time a tile on the mural cracked, he fired a copy himself and swapped it in at night after his shift. Sixty-three tiles on that wall are his now, and almost no one can tell except the station master. On Night 10, before the demolition crew arrives, he means to pry his sixty-three tiles off and take them home. They are his, but it is against the rules, and he cannot do it alone.

arc.zh: 初见：第一次跟检修班下隧道，他把一块松动的瓷砖塞进「我」手里，说「别告诉站长」。
arc.en: First meeting: on my first walk down the tunnel with the maintenance crew, he presses a loose tile into my hand: "Don't tell the station master."

arc.zh: 熟识：收工后在夜宵铺吃宵夜，他教「我」分辨隧道里的声音，夸「我」一句「还行」。
arc.en: Familiar: midnight noodles after his shift; he teaches me to tell the tunnel's sounds apart and tells me I'm "not bad".

arc.zh: 心事：拆除公告贴出来那天，他站在壁画前看了很久，一句话没说；他工具箱里总有一块没上釉的砖坯。
arc.en: Worries: the day the demolition notice goes up he stands in front of the mural a long time and says nothing; there is always an unglazed tile blank in his toolbox.

arc.zh: 秘密：检修通道的应急灯下，他打开一个旧鞋盒，里面是一摞自己烧的备用砖，承认墙上有六十三块是他的。
arc.en: Secret: under an emergency lamp in the walkway he opens an old shoebox full of spare tiles he fired himself, and admits sixty-three tiles on the wall are his.

arc.zh: 抉择：第十夜，要不要陪他在拆除队来之前，把那六十三块砖一块一块撬下来。
arc.en: Choice: on Night 10, will I help him pry those sixty-three tiles off, one by one, before the demolition crew comes.

text.zh: 第十夜，拆除队进场之前
text.en: Night 10, before the demolition crew arrives

keepsakeIdeas.zh: 一块他亲手烧的青色瓷砖、一盏用旧的头灯、检修日志里他画的一张隧道草图
keepsakeIdeas.en: a blue-green tile he fired himself, a worn headlamp, a tunnel sketch he drew in the maintenance log

role.zh: 青柳站的站长，五十八岁，在这个站干了二十二年，跟着老 7 号线一起退休。「我」的直属领导，规矩多，说话报时间；值班日志一天不落。
role.en: Qingliu's stationmaster, fifty-eight, twenty-two years at this station, retiring together with old Line 7. My direct boss: full of rules, quotes the time, never misses a day of the duty log.

look.zh: 一只老乌龟，戴藏蓝色大檐帽，龟壳上的纹路像一张线路图
look.en: an old tortoise in a navy peaked cap, the pattern on his shell like a route map

voice.zh: 慢、稳，句句带时间和规定：「23:55 清客，一个不落。」从不夸人，只说「记日志」。有事不直说，把东西放在桌上就走。叫「我」「小唐」。
voice.en: Slow and steady, every sentence a time or a rule: "Clear the station at 23:55. Every last one." Never praises anyone, only says "Log it." Never says what he means; leaves something on the desk and walks away. Calls me "Little Tang".

samples.zh: 23:55 清客，一个不落。……落了的，记日志。
samples.en: Clear the station at 23:55. Every last one. ...Anyone missed, log it.

samples.zh: 末班车不等人。人可以等末班车。
samples.en: The last train waits for no one. People can wait for the last train.

samples.zh: 钥匙放桌上了。我什么都没看见。
samples.en: Keys are on the desk. I didn't see a thing.

role.zh: B 口夜宵铺的老板娘，开到凌晨三点，地铁夜班的人都在她这儿吃。谁今晚多点了一碗、谁好几天没来，她都知道；她每晚给许念多煮一个蛋，从不收钱，也从不问。
role.en: Owner of the noodle shop by Exit B, open till three in the morning; everyone on the metro night shift eats here. She knows who ordered an extra bowl tonight and who hasn't come in for days; every night she boils Xu Nian an extra egg, never charges for it, never asks.

look.zh: 一只母鸡，红冠子，系一条洗得发白的蓝围裙
look.en: a hen with a red comb and a faded blue apron

voice.zh: 嗓门大、语速快，满嘴「靓仔」「食咗未」；心里有数的事不说破，只往碗里多加东西。叫「我」「新来的靓仔」。
voice.en: Loud and fast, "handsome" and "eaten yet?" in every breath; what she knows she never says outright, she just adds more to your bowl. Calls me "handsome new boy".

samples.zh: 新来的靓仔，食咗未？坐，粉马上到。
samples.en: Handsome new boy, eaten yet? Sit. Noodles coming.

samples.zh: 那个画画的妹仔，蛋我照煮。她不来，我就自己吃。
samples.en: The girl who draws, I boil her egg anyway. If she doesn't come, I eat it myself.

samples.zh: 车停了，我这锅也该歇歇了。……才怪，我开到地球爆炸。
samples.en: Trains stop, my pot should rest too. ...As if. I'm open till the world ends.

role.zh: 控制中心的夜班调度员，只在对讲机里出现，从不露面。声音平得像念稿，每晚 00:50 准时说一句「7 号线收车，辛苦」。
role.en: The night dispatcher at the control centre, heard only over the radio, never seen. Flat as a script, and every night at 00:50 sharp he says, "Line 7 is in for the night. Thanks, everyone."

look.zh: 只是对讲机里的一个声音
look.en: only a voice on the radio

voice.zh: 对讲机腔，先报呼号再说事：「青柳，调度呼叫。」从不带情绪，只在最后一夜破例。
voice.en: Radio voice, call sign first: "Qingliu, dispatch calling." Never any feeling in it, except on the very last night.

samples.zh: 青柳，调度呼叫。末班车已过江心站，预计 23:49 到你站。
samples.en: Qingliu, dispatch calling. Last train has passed Jiangxin, expected at your station 23:49.

samples.zh: 末班车司机，请复诵信号。……请复诵。
samples.en: Last train driver, repeat the signal. ...Repeat, please.
Line 7 is in for the night. Thanks, everyone.

text.zh: 晚舟当年在青柳站实习，是韦站长带出来的。
text.en: Wanzhou trained at Qingliu under Wei.

text.zh: 阿珍每晚给许念多煮一个蛋，不收钱；许念以为阿珍只是心好。
text.en: Every night Ah-Zhen boils Nian an extra egg for free; Nian thinks Ah-Zhen is simply kind.

text.zh: 阿珍早就看见许念每晚坐末班车去终点、从不回来，猜到她没地方住，等她自己开口。
text.en: Ah-Zhen noticed long ago that Nian rides to the terminus every night and never comes back; she has guessed Nian has nowhere to live and is waiting for her to say so.

text.zh: 韦站长知道壁画上有六十三块砖是程野换的，八年来一次也没记进日志。
text.en: Wei knows sixty-three tiles on the mural are Cheng Ye's replacements and in eight years has never once logged it.

text.zh: 检修班每晚在青柳站台尽头集合，退在安全线后面，等末班车到终点、调度 00:50 收车以后才下隧道；车出站时晚舟把车头灯闪一下，程野用头灯回一下。两人几乎没当面说过话。
text.en: The maintenance crew gathers at the end of the Qingliu platform every night, standing back behind the safety line, and goes down only after the last train reaches the terminus and dispatch closes the line at 00:50; as the train pulls out Wanzhou flashes her headlights once and Cheng Ye answers with his headlamp. They have barely ever spoken face to face.

text.zh: 两个人都守着站厅那面墙，互相不知道对方。
text.en: Both of them keep watch over the concourse wall, and neither knows about the other.

text.zh: 韦站长从不夸「我」，只让「我」记日志；他把日志里写不进去的事，用把东西放在桌上的方式告诉「我」。
text.en: Wei never praises me, only tells me to log things; what can't go in the log he tells me by leaving things on the desk.

title.en: Act I · Behind the White Line

goal.zh: 开端：「我」第一次上夜班，认识三个只在深夜出现的人；每个人都守着一件快结束的事，谁也不说。
goal.en: Opening: my first night shifts; I meet three people who only appear late at night, each guarding something about to end, none of them saying so.

text.zh: 末班车进站，司机按了两声短喇叭，探出头说「新来的，白线后面」。
text.en: The last train pulls in; the driver gives two short horns, leans out and says, "New guy, behind the white line."

text.zh: 末班车上「我」在许念的速写本里看见了自己；她说她在一块一块画青柳站的壁画，拆之前想画完。
text.en: On the last train I find myself in Nian's sketchbook; she says she is drawing Qingliu's mural tile by tile and wants to finish before it comes down.

promise.zh: 答应壁画拆掉之前，陪她把每一块砖都画完
promise.en: promise to help her draw every last tile before the mural comes down

text.zh: 第一次跟检修班下隧道，程野把一块松动的瓷砖塞进「我」手里：「别告诉站长。」
text.en: My first walk down the tunnel with the maintenance crew; Cheng Ye presses a loose tile into my hand: "Don't tell the station master."

hook.zh: 收车以后，站厅的老挂钟还是停在 00:47。韦站长说那是末班车到终点的时间，它停了十几年，没人去修。
hook.en: After closing the concourse clock still says 00:47. Wei says that is when the last train reaches the terminus; it stopped over ten years ago and no one has fixed it.

goal.zh: 转折：拆除公告贴出来，壁画不保留；每个人「快结束的事」都开始露出来。
goal.en: Turn: the demolition notice goes up and the mural will not be kept; everyone's "thing about to end" starts to show.

text.zh: 站厅贴出公告：壁画随旧站拆除，不做保留。许念对着公告画了一张速写；程野站在壁画前看了很久，一句话没说。两人隔着一个闸机，谁也没注意谁。
text.en: A notice goes up in the concourse: the mural comes down with the old station and will not be kept. Nian sketches the notice; Cheng Ye stands before the mural a long time and says nothing. One gate apart, neither notices the other.

text.zh: 对讲机里晚舟晚报了一个黄灯，调度问了两遍；车到青柳，她下车揉着眼睛，说隧道里的灯今年暗了。
text.en: On the radio Wanzhou calls a yellow signal late and dispatch asks twice; at Qingliu she steps out rubbing her eyes and says the tunnel lamps have gone dim this year.

promise.zh: 答应最后一班车申请添乘，坐在驾驶室里陪她开完
promise.en: promise to apply to ride in the cab on the last train and keep her company to the end of the line

text.zh: 末班车到了终点，许念没有走向任何一个小区，而是推开了江尾站外那家自助洗衣店的门；她回头看见「我」，说「别问」。
text.en: At the terminus Nian walks toward no housing estate at all, but pushes open the door of the laundromat outside Jiangwei; she turns, sees me, and says, "Don't ask."

text.zh: 收工后程野打开一个旧鞋盒，里面是一摞他自己烧的瓷砖；他问「我」第十夜能不能帮个忙。
text.en: After his shift Cheng Ye opens an old shoebox full of tiles he fired himself and asks if I can help him with something on Night 10.

promise.zh: 答应第十夜拆除队来之前，帮他把他的那些砖一块块撬下来
promise.en: promise to help him pry his tiles off one by one on Night 10, before the demolition crew arrives

hook.zh: 韦站长把一串钥匙放在值班室桌上，说「我什么都没看见」，就去巡站了。
hook.en: Wei puts a ring of keys on the duty-office desk, says, "I didn't see a thing," and goes off on his rounds.

goal.zh: 高潮：洗衣店关门、壁画的最后一夜、最后一班车；所有「快结束的事」都到了点。
goal.en: Climax: the laundromat closes, the mural's last night, the last train; every "thing about to end" falls due.

text.zh: 韦站长翻开二十二年的值班日志给「我」看，说「末班车不等人，人可以等末班车」。
text.en: Wei opens twenty-two years of duty logs for me and says, "The last train waits for no one. People can wait for the last train."

text.zh: 壁画的最后一夜，许念对着最后几块砖；程野扛着工具箱进了站厅。两个人第一次看见对方。
text.en: The mural's last night; Nian faces the last few tiles, and Cheng Ye walks into the concourse with his toolbox. They see each other for the first time.

text.zh: 最后一班车 23:51 从青柳开出；站台上挤满了来送它的人。
text.en: The last train leaves Qingliu at 23:51; the platform is crowded with people who came to see it off.

text.zh: 地面上下起了暴雨，A 口的台阶淌成小瀑布，进站的人都在抖伞。
text.en: A downpour at street level; the steps at Exit A turn into a small waterfall, and everyone coming in shakes out an umbrella.

text.zh: 失物招领柜里多了一只没人认领的白手套，韦站长让「我」记日志：「一只，左手。」
text.en: A single unclaimed white glove turns up in the lost-and-found; Wei has me log it: "One. Left hand."

text.zh: 阿珍往「我」碗里多放了一个蛋，说今天的蛋煮多了。
text.en: Ah-Zhen drops an extra egg into my bowl and says she boiled too many today.

text.zh: 调度广播：前方站信号检修，末班车晚点三分钟。站台上的人一起抬头看了看钟。
text.en: Dispatch announces signal work ahead; the last train is three minutes late. Everyone on the platform looks up at the clock at once.

text.zh: 末班车上一个加班的上班族睡过了站，醒来问「这是哪」，又笑着说「算了，反正明天还要坐回来」。
text.en: An office worker on the last train sleeps past his stop, wakes up asking "Where are we?", then laughs: "Never mind. I'll be riding back tomorrow anyway."

text.zh: 来拍老站的人越来越多，有人对着停在 00:47 的挂钟拍了好几张。
text.en: More and more people come to photograph the old station; someone takes several shots of the clock stuck at 00:47.

text.zh: 隧道深处一盏应急灯坏了，程野用头灯照着换灯泡，嘴里叼着螺丝。
text.en: Deep in the tunnel an emergency lamp is out; Cheng Ye changes the bulb by his headlamp, a screw between his teeth.

text.zh: 「我」第一次上夜班；站厅里贴着「老 7 号线第 10 夜停运」的通知
text.en: My first night shift; a notice in the concourse says old Line 7 closes after Night 10

text.zh: 拆除公告贴出：壁画随旧站拆除，不做保留
text.en: The demolition notice goes up: the mural comes down with the station and will not be kept

text.zh: 来拍老站的人多了起来
text.en: More people start coming to photograph the old station

text.zh: 江尾站外的自助洗衣店关门转租；壁画的最后一夜
text.en: The laundromat outside Jiangwei closes for good; the mural's last night

text.zh: 老 7 号线最后一班车，23:51 从青柳开出
text.en: Old Line 7's last train, leaving Qingliu at 23:51

mood.zh: 公告栏前围着几个人，壁画在灯下颜色发旧
mood.en: a few people gathered at the notice board, the mural faded under the lights

mood.zh: 收车以后，站厅只开了一排灯，壁画前铺着一张旧报纸
mood.en: after closing, one row of lights left on, an old newspaper spread in front of the mural

mood.zh: 站台上挤满了来送车的人，有人举着手机，有人只是站着
mood.en: the platform packed with people seeing the train off, some holding up phones, some just standing

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了约定，韦站长签了添乘单，你坐进驾驶室，和她一起把每一个信号念出声，调度照常一个个确认。00:47 到江尾，她关掉驾驶室的灯，把领口那枚旧哨子摘下来放进你手心：「以后我站白线后面，你记得来接我下班。」恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your promise; Wei signs the ride-along slip, you sit in the cab and call each signal aloud with her while dispatch confirms them one by one as usual. At 00:47 at Jiangwei she switches off the cab lights and puts the old whistle from her collar into your palm: "From now on I stand behind the white line. Remember to come and walk me home after work." Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：最后一班车是她一个人开完的。驶过青柳时，她按了两声短喇叭，你在白线后面挥手。第二天她发来一条消息：「明天起我上白班了。一起吃个早饭？」
brief.en: Good ending: she drives the last train alone. Passing Qingliu she gives two short horns, and you wave from behind the white line. Next day she texts: "Day shift from tomorrow. Breakfast together?"

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应她的事没做到。最后一班车驶过青柳，她没有按喇叭；你在站台上看着车尾的红灯一点点缩进隧道。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word to her. The last train passes Qingliu without a horn; from the platform you watch its red tail lights shrink into the tunnel.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：停运以后她去了车辆段。你去外地之前，她在对讲机的旧频道里说了一句「唐越，正点」，就再没有下文。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: after the closure she goes to the depot. Before you leave town she says one line on the old radio channel, "Tang Yue, on time," and nothing after.

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了约定，壁画拆掉前的最后一夜，你们一起画完了最后一块砖。天亮前她自己给学校打了电话，阿珍的二楼空房先借给她住。展览那天，四百三十二块砖排满一整面墙，角落里写着你的名字。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your promise, and on the mural's last night the two of you draw the last tile together. Before dawn she calls the school herself, and Ah-Zhen lends her the empty room upstairs for now. At her exhibition four hundred and thirty-two tiles fill a whole wall, with your name in the corner. Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：壁画差两块没画完，她说「留两块给记性」。她把速写本第四十七页撕给你，上面是你们第一次在末班车上遇见时的你；住处的事，她说她已经开口了。
brief.en: Good ending: two tiles are left undrawn, and she says, "Two for memory to fill in." She tears out page forty-seven for you: you, the first time you met on the last train. As for where she lives, she says she has finally told someone.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应她的事没做到。洗衣店关门那天她就离开了沿江，速写本最后一页是空的；你只记得终点站外那盏一直亮着的灯。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word to her. She leaves Yanjiang the day the laundromat closes, and the last page of her sketchbook is blank; all you remember is the light that never went off outside the terminus.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：她搬去了同学家暂住。分别那天你们交换了东西，她给你一张速写，你给她一张站厅的照片，谁都没说下一站在哪。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: she moves onto a classmate's sofa for now. On the day you part you trade: a sketch for you, a photo of the concourse for her, and neither says where the next stop is.

brief.zh: 真结局：你守住了约定，第十夜你们赶在拆除队之前，把他的六十三块砖一块块撬了下来。天亮时他在夜宵铺的后墙上拼出一小片江和一条早班船，说「还行。……我是说，有你在，还行」。恋爱结局。
brief.en: True ending: you keep your promise, and on Night 10, ahead of the demolition crew, the two of you pry off his sixty-three tiles one by one. At dawn he sets a small piece of river and an early ferry into the back wall of the noodle shop and says, "Not bad. ...I mean, with you here, not bad." Romance ending.

brief.zh: 好结局：砖是他一个人撬完的，凌晨四点他把一块青色的砖塞进你手里，说「这块，给你」。你走的那天，他用头灯在站外闪了一下。
brief.en: Good ending: he pries the tiles off alone, and at four in the morning presses a blue-green one into your hand: "This one. For you." The day you leave, he flashes his headlamp once outside the station.

brief.zh: 坏结局：你答应他的事没做到。拆除队进场时，那六十三块砖还在墙上，和别的砖一起碎了；他在夜宵铺坐了一夜，没再说「还行」。
brief.en: Bad ending: you broke your word to him. When the demolition crew arrives the sixty-three tiles are still on the wall, and they break with all the others; he sits in the noodle shop all night and never says "not bad" again.

brief.zh: 恋人未满：你走之前，他在检修日志最后一页画了一张隧道草图，旁边写着「小唐，到此一游」。
brief.en: Not quite lovers: before you leave he draws a sketch of the tunnel on the last page of the maintenance log, with "Little Tang was here" beside it.

title.zh: 青柳站的最后一张合影

brief.zh: 隐藏群像结局：你和三个人都走到了心事这一步，却没有和谁走到最后。最后一班车开走以后，韦站长、阿珍、晚舟、许念、程野和你挤在停在 00:47 的挂钟下拍了一张合影；对讲机里调度破例多说了一句：「青柳，辛苦了。」
brief.en: Hidden ensemble ending: you reached each of them, but went all the way with none. After the last train leaves, Wei, Ah-Zhen, Wanzhou, Nian, Cheng Ye and you squeeze under the clock stuck at 00:47 for one photo; on the radio, dispatch breaks habit and adds, "Qingliu, thank you."

brief.zh: 普通结局：你做完了十个夜班，在日志最后一页写下「00:50，收车」。第二天你坐上去外地的高铁，窗外的城市里，再也没有那条老 7 号线。
brief.en: Normal ending: you finish ten night shifts and write "00:50, in for the night" on the log's last page. Next day you board a train to another city; in the city outside the window, old Line 7 is gone.

finale.zh: 最后一句点题「00:47」或「末班车」，落在一个具体的夜里画面上（白线、隧道口的风、停住的挂钟之一）。
finale.en: The last sentence should echo the title, 00:47 or the last train, and land on one concrete night image (the white line, wind from the tunnel mouth, or the stopped clock).

loading.en: A gust of wind comes up the tunnel...

loading.zh: 站台广播的回声慢慢散了…
loading.en: The echo of an announcement fades...
Steam rises from the noodle pot...

text.zh: 老站里一件没人修的东西
text.en: one more thing nobody fixed in an old station

text.zh: 末班车到终点的时间

text.zh: 一个夜晚该结束的时候
text.en: the moment a night is meant to end

payoff.zh: 最后一班车到站的那一分钟
payoff.en: the minute the last train arrives

thing.zh: 到青柳时的两声短喇叭

text.zh: 司机跟新来的打招呼
text.en: the driver saying hello to the new guy

text.zh: 她每晚都按，一次没落
text.en: she gives them every night without fail

text.zh: 最后一次
text.en: the last time

thing.zh: 站台上那条白漆的安全线

text.zh: 「白线后面」，一句规定
text.en: "behind the white line", a rule

text.zh: 她以后要站的地方
text.en: where she will stand from now on

text.en: her pillow in the laundromat

text.zh: 她报出来的一个数

text.en: only when it's finished will she think about a place to live

thing.en: the tile blank in Cheng Ye's toolbox

text.zh: 检修工随手带着的一块砖
text.en: a tile a maintenance worker happens to carry

text.zh: 他擦得比扳手还仔细
text.en: he wipes it more carefully than his wrench

text.zh: 墙上有六十三块是他的
text.en: sixty-three tiles on the wall are his

payoff.zh: 第十夜撬下来的那些砖
payoff.en: the tiles pried off on Night 10

thing.zh: 车头灯和头灯互相闪一下
thing.en: headlights and a headlamp flashing once at each other

text.en: a tunnel habit

text.en: how two people of the night say hello

text.en: the ledger Wei makes me keep

text.zh: 写不进去的事，比写进去的多
text.en: more left out of it than written in

staging.zh: 第一夜，青柳站台，23:49。隧道口先来一阵风，然后是车灯。车停稳前两声短喇叭。她拉开驾驶室侧窗，只探出半张脸。她先开口。
staging.en: Night one, Qingliu platform, 23:49. First a gust from the tunnel mouth, then the headlights. Two short horns before the train stops. She slides open the cab's side window and shows half a face. She speaks first.

text.zh: 隧道口先吹出一阵风，把「我」的帽檐掀了起来，然后才是车灯。
text.en: A gust from the tunnel mouth lifts the brim of my cap before the headlights even appear.

text.zh: 车停稳之前，响了两声短喇叭。
text.en: Before the train stops, two short horns.

text.zh: 新来的，白线后面。
text.en: New guy. Behind the white line.

text.zh: 我在白线后面啊。
text.en: I am behind the white line.

text.zh: 帽子没在。……车进站带风，下回按住。
text.en: Your cap isn't. ...Trains bring wind. Hold it next time.
23:49. On time.

staging.zh: 末班车车厢，整节车只有四五个人。她坐在对面，本子立在膝盖上，铅笔一直在动。「我」看见本子上是自己。她不慌，反而让「我」别动。
staging.en: The last train car, four or five people in the whole carriage. She sits across from me, sketchbook propped on her knees, pencil never still. I see myself on the page. She isn't flustered; she tells me to hold still.

text.zh: 她本子上那个靠着门打瞌睡的人，制服跟「我」一模一样。
text.en: The figure dozing against the door in her sketchbook is wearing my exact uniform.

text.zh: 别动别动——你刚才那个姿势很好看，别浪费。
text.en: Don't move, don't move. That pose was nice. Don't waste it.

text.zh: 你画陌生人都不问的吗？
text.en: You draw strangers without asking?

text.zh: 问了就不好看了。……站务员，你是青柳站的？
text.en: Asking ruins it. ...Attendant, you're from Qingliu?

text.zh: 那面墙，一共四百三十二块砖。我画到第二百六十块了。
text.en: That wall has four hundred and thirty-two tiles. I'm up to two hundred and sixty.

unsaid.zh: 她为什么每晚都坐到终点。
unsaid.en: Why she rides to the end of the line every night.

staging.zh: 凌晨一点的检修通道，头灯照出一小圈。他走在前面，不回头，只在要紧处停一下。走到站厅背面的检修口，他从墙缝里摸出一块松了的瓷砖。
staging.en: The maintenance walkway at one in the morning, a small circle of headlamp light. He walks ahead without looking back, stopping only where it matters. At the inspection hatch behind the concourse he works a loose tile out of a crack.

text.zh: 嗯。……脚踩枕木中间，别踩钢轨。钢轨滑。
text.en: Mm. ...Step between the sleepers. Not on the rail. Rails are slippery.

text.zh: 他从检修口的墙缝里抠出一块瓷砖，用袖子擦了擦，蓝色从灰底下露出来。
text.en: He works a tile out of the crack by the hatch and wipes it with his sleeve; blue shows through the dust.

text.zh: 这块，你先拿着。
text.en: This one. Hold it for now.

text.zh: 这是壁画上的？
text.en: Is it from the mural?

text.zh: 别告诉站长。……你就当没看见。
text.en: Don't tell the station master. ...Pretend you didn't see it.

staging.zh: 傍晚的站厅，公告栏前围着几个人。许念蹲在公告前面画公告本身，画完才开口；程野站在壁画前，手插在背心口袋里。两个人隔着一个闸机，谁也没看谁。「我」站在中间。
staging.en: The concourse in the evening, a few people at the notice board. Nian crouches in front of the notice and draws the notice itself, speaking only once she has finished; Cheng Ye stands in front of the mural, hands in his vest pockets. One gate apart, neither looks at the other. I stand between them.

text.zh: 公告只有三行字，最后一行是「站内壁画随站拆除，不做保留」。
text.en: The notice is three lines long; the last says, "The mural in the station will be removed with it and not kept."

text.zh: 「不做保留」。四个字，比我画一块砖还快。
text.en: "Not kept." Two words. Faster than I can draw one tile.

text.zh: 闸机那边，程野伸手碰了碰壁画右下角的一块砖，又把手收回口袋里。
text.en: Across the gate, Cheng Ye touches a tile in the mural's lower right corner, then puts his hand back in his pocket.

text.zh: 站务员，还剩几天？
text.en: Attendant, how many days left?

text.zh: 六天。
text.en: Six.

text.zh: 一百五十块砖，六天。……够了。够了吧？
text.en: A hundred and fifty tiles in six days. ...That's enough. That's enough, right?

unsaid.zh: 闸机那边的人也在看同一面墙。
unsaid.en: That the man across the gate is looking at the same wall.

staging.zh: 青柳站台，末班车进站之前，「我」手里的对讲机传来调度和她的对话。车进站后，她下车透口气，站在白线后面揉眼睛。她不解释，只说灯的事。
staging.en: Qingliu platform, before the last train comes in; the radio in my hand carries dispatch talking to her. Once the train is in, she steps out for a breath of air and stands behind the white line rubbing her eyes. She explains nothing, only talks about the lamps.

text.zh: 末班车司机，请复诵信号。……请复诵。
text.en: Last train driver, repeat the signal. ...Repeat, please.

text.zh: ……黄灯，减速。收到。
text.en: ...Yellow. Slowing. Copy.

text.zh: 车进站以后，她下车站在白线后面，用手背按了按眼睛。
text.en: After the train comes in she steps out, stands behind the white line and presses the back of her hand to her eyes.

text.zh: 隧道里的灯，今年好像暗了一点。
text.en: The tunnel lamps seem a bit dimmer this year.

text.zh: 你眼睛不舒服？
text.en: Are your eyes bothering you?

text.zh: 没事。……绿灯我还看得见。
text.en: It's fine. ...I can still see green.

staging.zh: 江尾站外，凌晨一点，整条街只有自助洗衣店亮着。她推门进去，在靠窗的塑料椅上坐下，把速写本垫在脑后。回头看见「我」，她先笑。
staging.en: Outside Jiangwei at one in the morning, only the self-service laundromat lit on the whole street. She goes in, sits on the plastic chair by the window and puts her sketchbook behind her head. She turns, sees me, and smiles first.

text.zh: 洗衣店里一台烘干机在转，空的，没放衣服。
text.en: One dryer in the laundromat is turning, empty, no clothes inside.

text.zh: ……别问。
text.en: ...Don't ask.

text.zh: 我没问。
text.en: I didn't.

text.zh: 你脸上问了。灰绿色的，一直在问。
text.en: Your face did. Grey-green, asking the whole time.

text.zh: 这里有空调，有灯，凌晨三点有人来收硬币。……挺好的。真的。
text.en: There's air-con, there's light, someone comes to empty the coins at three. ...It's fine. Really.

unsaid.zh: 她已经一个月没有住处。
unsaid.en: That she has had nowhere to live for a month.

staging.zh: 收工以后，一盏应急灯下。他打开一个旧鞋盒，里面用报纸隔着一摞瓷砖，颜色和壁画一模一样。他先说数字，再说请求，中间停了很久。
staging.en: After his shift, under an emergency lamp. He opens an old shoebox: a stack of tiles separated by newspaper, the exact colours of the mural. He gives a number first, then a request, with a long pause between.

text.zh: 鞋盒里的砖用报纸一层层隔着，最上面一块还没上釉，是灰白的砖坯。
text.en: The tiles in the shoebox are layered with newspaper; the top one is unglazed, a grey-white blank.

text.zh: 嗯。……这些是备用的。墙上那些，有一些是我烧的。
text.en: Mm. ...These are spares. Some of the ones on the wall, I fired.

text.zh: 一些是多少？
text.en: How many is some?

text.zh: 六十三块。
text.en: Sixty-three.

text.zh: 他把鞋盒盖上，又打开，又盖上。
text.en: He closes the shoebox, opens it, closes it again.

text.zh: 第十夜，拆除队来之前。……我一个人，撬不完。
text.en: Night ten, before the demolition crew. ...On my own, I can't get them all off.

unsaid.en: That the station master has known all along.

title.en: The Tile in the Wrong Blue

staging.zh: 第九夜收车以后，站厅只开了一排灯。许念坐在壁画前的旧报纸上，面前是最后几块砖。程野扛着工具箱从检修口进来，看见她，停住。「我」在两人之间。这一幕停在他们第一次说话之后，不替结局决定画没画完、她有没有开口。
staging.en: Night nine after closing, one row of lights in the concourse. Nian sits on old newspaper in front of the mural, the last few tiles before her. Cheng Ye comes in through the inspection hatch with his toolbox, sees her, and stops. I am between them. The scene stops after they first speak; it does not decide for the endings whether the drawing gets finished or whether she speaks up.

text.zh: 你是谁？……拆除队不是明天才来吗。
text.en: Who are you? ...Isn't the demolition crew coming tomorrow?

text.zh: 嗯。我不是拆的。
text.en: Mm. I'm not here to tear it down.

text.zh: 她的铅笔停在一块砖上。那块的蓝，比旁边的都新一点。
text.en: Her pencil stops on one tile. Its blue is a little newer than the ones around it.

text.zh: 这一块，我画了三遍都不对。颜色太新了。
text.en: This one, I've drawn it three times and it's never right. The colour is too new.

text.zh: ……嗯。去年换的。
text.en: ...Mm. Changed last year.

staging.zh: 第十夜，23:50，青柳站台挤满了送车的人。她从驾驶室侧窗探出来，看了一眼站台上的时钟，又看「我」。这一幕停在车门关上之前，「我」站在哪里由选择决定。
staging.en: Night ten, 23:50, the Qingliu platform packed with people seeing the train off. She leans out of the cab's side window, glances at the platform clock, then at me. The scene stops before the doors close; where I stand is up to the choice.

text.zh: 站台上有人在拍车头，有人在拍「青柳」两个字，有个老人只是摸了摸立柱。
text.en: People photograph the cab, people photograph the word "Qingliu", one old man just touches a pillar.

text.zh: 23:50。还有一分钟。
text.en: 23:50. One minute.

text.zh: 00:47 到江尾。最后一次，跟站厅那个钟对上。
text.en: 00:47 at Jiangwei. Last time it matches the clock in the concourse.

text.zh: 唐越。……你站哪儿，自己选。
text.en: Tang Yue. ...Where you stand, you choose.

unsaid.en: That this is her last drive.

staging.zh: 傍晚的夜宵铺，她交班前在这儿吃一碗粉，制服外套搭在椅背上。「我」随口问到哪一站要多久，她不看手机，一口气报完。
staging.en: The noodle shop in the evening; she eats a bowl before her shift, uniform jacket over the chair. I ask offhand how long to some station; without looking at a phone she recites them all in one breath.

text.zh: 从青柳到江尾要多久？
text.en: How long from Qingliu to Jiangwei?
Qingliu departs 23:51, Liu'an 23:56, Old Pier 00:03, Textile Mill 00:11, Nanwan 00:20, Luzhou 00:31, Jiangwei 00:47.

text.zh: 晚舟，粉要坨啦。
text.en: Wanzhou, your noodles are going soggy.

text.zh: ……五十六分钟。你问的是这个吧。
text.en: ...Fifty-six minutes. That's what you asked, right?

staging.zh: 收车以后的检修通道，两人站在应急灯下，他让「我」把头灯压低、别出声。他一样一样指给「我」听。
staging.en: The walkway after service; standing under an emergency lamp, he has me tilt my headlamp down and keep quiet. He points out each sound.

text.zh: 头灯压低。……听。
text.en: Lamp down. ...Listen.

text.zh: 滴水声，远处排风扇的嗡嗡声，还有一种很细的、像有人在很远的地方吹口哨的声音。
text.en: Dripping water, the hum of a distant exhaust fan, and something very thin, like someone whistling far away.

text.zh: 那个口哨是什么？
text.en: What's the whistling?

text.zh: 风过道岔。……它一响，就是要下雨了。
text.en: Wind through the points. ...When it sings, rain's coming.

text.zh: 还行。你耳朵还行。
text.en: Not bad. Your ears are not bad.

staging.zh: 傍晚的站厅，她坐在壁画前的台阶上画砖，「我」站在旁边挡着路过的人。她画的时候一个字不说；每画完一块，才抬头给车站里的一个人配一个颜色。
staging.en: The concourse in the evening; she sits on the step in front of the mural drawing tiles while I stand guard against passers-by. She says nothing while drawing; each time she finishes a tile she looks up and gives one person in the station a colour.

text.zh: 站长是深绿色的，旧铁皮柜那种。阿珍是橘红色，锅底火那种。
text.en: The station master is dark green, old filing-cabinet green. Ah-Zhen is orange-red, flame-under-the-pot red.

text.zh: 末班车司机呢？
text.en: And the last-train driver?

text.zh: 凌晨四点的天，蓝里带一点灰。……你呢，还是灰绿色。
text.en: The sky at four in the morning, blue with a little grey. ...You're still grey-green.

text.zh: 灰绿色是好是坏？
text.en: Is grey-green good or bad?

text.zh: 你刚才说什么？……哦。灰绿色是青柳站站名牌的颜色。你自己想。
text.en: What did you just say? ...Oh. Grey-green is the colour of Qingliu's station sign. Work it out.

commonGoal.zh: 共通线：三个夜里的人都露面，每人一个反常：司机每晚到青柳按两声喇叭、画画的人从不坐回程、检修工让「我」别告诉站长。
commonGoal.en: Common route: all three night people appear, each with one oddity: the driver's two horns at Qingliu, the artist who never rides back, the maintenance worker's "don't tell the station master".

goal.zh: 个人线·晚舟：信号、喇叭、白线；最后一班车，最后一次开车。
goal.en: Wanzhou route: signals, horns, the white line; the last train, her last drive.

others.zh: 许念照常每晚坐到终点；程野的头灯在隧道深处闪一下。
others.en: Nian still rides to the end every night; Cheng Ye's headlamp flashes once deep in the tunnel.

goal.zh: 个人线·许念：四百三十二块砖和一盏洗衣店的灯。
goal.en: Nian route: four hundred and thirty-two tiles and one laundromat light.

others.zh: 晚舟到青柳照样按两声喇叭；程野在站厅背面补着什么。
others.en: Wanzhou still gives two horns at Qingliu; Cheng Ye is mending something behind the concourse wall.

goal.zh: 个人线·程野：一面别人都以为是原样的墙，和六十三块他自己烧的砖。
goal.en: Cheng Ye route: a wall everyone thinks is original, and sixty-three tiles he fired himself.

others.zh: 许念对着壁画画到半夜；晚舟的车头灯每晚闪一下检修班。
others.en: Nian draws the mural until midnight; Wanzhou's headlights flash at the maintenance crew every night.

ensemble.zh: 群像线：最后一班车开走以后，三个人的事在停住的挂钟下一起收尾。
ensemble.en: Ensemble route: after the last train leaves, all three threads close together under the stopped clock.

truth.zh: 到青柳的两声喇叭，是她实习那年和韦站长约好的：「到了按两声，我就知道你平安。」她开车这五年，他每晚 23:49 都站在站台上听。第一夜她多看了「我」一眼，是因为那天站台上站的是一个新来的人，而他站在新人身后。
truth.en: The two horns at Qingliu were a deal she made with Wei the year she trained: "Give two when you arrive, and I'll know you're safe." Every night at 23:49 in her five years of driving he has stood on the platform to hear them. On the first night she looked twice at me because a new person was standing there, with him just behind.

reframes.en: the two short horns on the first night

reframes.zh: 韦站长每晚 23:49 都出现在站台上
reframes.en: Wei turning up on the platform at 23:49 every night

truth.zh: 阿珍早就看出许念每晚坐末班车去终点、从不回来。那个多煮的蛋，是她想不出别的办法时能做的唯一一件事；她楼上有一间空房，一直等许念开口。
truth.en: Ah-Zhen worked out long ago that Nian rides the last train to the end and never comes back. The extra egg was the one thing she could do when she couldn't think of anything else; there is an empty room upstairs, and she has been waiting for Nian to ask.

reframes.zh: 阿珍每晚多煮的那个蛋
reframes.en: the extra egg Ah-Zhen boils every night

reframes.zh: 阿珍那句「她不来，我就自己吃」
reframes.en: Ah-Zhen's "if she doesn't come, I eat it myself"

truth.zh: 韦站长八年来都知道壁画上有程野换的砖，一次也没记进日志。放在桌上的那串钥匙，是检修口和站厅侧门的；「我什么都没看见」是说给第十夜听的。
truth.en: For eight years Wei has known Cheng Ye was replacing tiles on the mural and never once logged it. The ring of keys he left on the desk opens the inspection hatch and the concourse side door; "I didn't see a thing" was meant for Night 10.

reframes.en: the ring of keys on the duty-office desk
Cheng Ye's "don't tell the station master"

text.zh: 小时候妈妈带「我」第一次坐 7 号线，从头坐到终点再坐回来，「我」趴在车窗上数隧道里的灯，数到睡着。
text.en: The first time Mum took me on Line 7 as a kid, we rode to the end and back, and I pressed my face to the window counting tunnel lamps until I fell asleep.

text.zh: 她第一次单独开末班车，到青柳时手心全是汗，按了两声喇叭，手才不抖了。
text.en: Her first solo last train: palms wet when she reached Qingliu; she gave two horns, and only then did her hands stop shaking.

text.zh: 大一的色彩课上，老师说她调的灰「有温度」，那天她在宿舍走廊上来回走了二十趟。
text.en: In first-year colour class her teacher said her greys "had warmth", and that night she walked the dorm corridor twenty times.

text.zh: 他烧的第一块砖在舅舅的小窑里裂成了两半，舅舅说「釉配得对，火急了」，他又等了三天才敢再开窑。
text.en: The first tile he ever fired cracked in two in his uncle's little kiln. "Glaze is right, fire was too hasty," his uncle said, and he waited three days before daring to fire again.

bits.zh: 新发的制服领子太硬，磨脖子
bits.en: the collar of the new uniform is stiff and chafes

bits.zh: 站厅地上的伞套堆成一小座山
bits.en: umbrella sleeves pile up in a small hill on the concourse floor

bits.zh: 夜宵铺来了一桌刚下班的护士
bits.en: a table of nurses just off shift at the noodle shop

bits.zh: 公告栏的玻璃上贴着一张手写的「舍不得」
bits.en: a handwritten "we'll miss you" taped to the notice-board glass

bits.zh: 值班室的风扇卡住了一片叶子
bits.en: the duty-office fan has one blade stuck

bits.zh: 江尾站外的路灯坏了两盏
有人在站台立柱上贴了一张「谢谢你，7 号线」
bits.en: someone has stuck "Thank you, Line 7" on a platform pillar

bits.zh: 韦站长的帽子放在日志上压着
bits.en: Wei's cap sitting on the log to hold it down

bits.zh: 洗衣店玻璃上贴出「转租」
bits.en: "To let" taped on the laundromat window

bits.zh: 站台上的人比任何一个早高峰都多
bits.en: more people on the platform than any morning rush

concourse.zh: 壁画右下角有一块砖的蓝比别的新
concourse.en: one tile in the mural's lower right is a newer blue than the rest

concourse.zh: 闸机的嘀声在空站厅里会回一下
concourse.en: in the empty concourse a gate's beep echoes once

platform.zh: 隧道口的风带着铁锈和机油味
platform.en: the tunnel wind smells of rust and machine oil

office.zh: 失物招领柜里有一把十年没人认领的伞
office.en: an umbrella in lost-and-found nobody has claimed in ten years

stall.zh: 锅边的辣椒罐用胶带缠着
stall.en: the chilli jar by the pot held together with tape

exit.zh: 外卖员在台阶上坐着等单
exit.en: delivery riders sitting on the steps waiting for orders

car.zh: 拉环一起晃，像一排钟摆
car.en: hand straps swaying together like a row of pendulums

terminal.zh: 出站口的自动门开了又关，外面没有人
terminal.en: the exit's automatic door opens and shuts on no one

tunnel.zh: 应急灯下的墙上用粉笔写着日期和名字
tunnel.en: dates and names chalked on the wall under an emergency lamp

any.en: the chime before the doors close

any.zh: 凌晨的路灯底下飞着小虫
any.en: small insects around a streetlight in the small hours

text.zh: 阿珍管所有男的叫「靓仔」，包括韦站长；韦站长每次都纠正「叫站长」，阿珍每次都说「好的靓仔」。
text.en: Ah-Zhen calls every man "handsome", Wei included; every time he corrects her, "Stationmaster," and every time she says, "Sure, handsome."

text.zh: 韦站长让「我」什么都记日志，连「22:13，站厅飞进一只蛾子」也要记，「我」开始怀疑日志比「我」先认识这个站。
text.en: Wei has me log everything, down to "22:13, a moth flew into the concourse"; I start to suspect the log knew this station before I did.

text.zh: 调度说什么都一个调子，连「有人在站台求婚，请注意秩序」也念得像天气预报。
text.en: Dispatch says everything in one tone, even "someone is proposing on the platform, please keep order", read like a weather report.

text.zh: 许念给每个人配颜色，配到后来连闸机都有颜色：「这台是不耐烦的黄。」
text.en: Nian gives everyone a colour, and eventually the gates get colours too: "This one is an impatient yellow."

text.zh: 「那个画画的妹仔，每晚坐末班车去终点，没见她坐回来过。」
text.en: "That girl who draws rides the last train to the end every night. Never seen her ride back."

text.zh: 「晚舟最近看菜单要凑得好近。我跟她说字没变小，她说那是灯暗了。」
text.en: "Wanzhou's been holding the menu right up to her face. I told her the writing hasn't shrunk, she said the light's dimmer."

text.zh: 「末班车司机复诵信号，比上周慢半拍。……记录在案。」
text.en: "Last-train driver repeating signals half a beat slower than last week. ...Noted."

text.zh: 「检修班那个程野，活干得细。细到有些活，日志里不用记。」
text.en: "Cheng Ye on the maintenance crew does careful work. So careful some of it doesn't need logging."

text.zh: 「新来的靓仔，三个人都跟他说过话了。……我这铺子以后有生意了。」
text.en: "The handsome new boy's already talking to all three of them. ...My shop's got business ahead."

habits.en: presses the back of her hand to her eyes

contradiction.zh: 比谁都守规定，却把自己的体检结果压着不报
contradiction.en: keeps every rule, yet sits on her own medical result

growth.zh: 从一个人看信号，到让别人替她报一次
growth.en: from watching signals alone to letting someone call them for her once

style.zh: 像行车日志：时间、站名、信号，最后一行才写一句自己的话
style.en: like a cab log: times, stations, signals; only the last line is her own

seesMe.zh: 每晚 23:49 站在白线后面的人
seesMe.en: the one behind the white line at 23:49 every night

seesMe.zh: 他听出我晚报了一个黄灯
seesMe.en: he heard me call a yellow late

dejaVu.zh: 「新来的……你好像不是第一次站这儿。」
dejaVu.en: "New guy... you don't seem new to this spot."

awayVoice.en: "23:49, Qingliu. No one behind the white line."

habits.en: laughs off questions about where she lives

contradiction.zh: 能一块不落地记下一面墙，却不肯开口说自己没地方住
contradiction.en: can record a whole wall tile by tile, but won't say she has nowhere to live

growth.en: from "after I finish" to speaking up first

style.zh: 写在速写本的背面，句子很短，每句后面标一个颜色
style.en: on the back of sketch pages, short sentences, each tagged with a colour

seesMe.en: the one who keeps people out of my way
he saw me go into the laundromat

seesMe.zh: 灰绿色是青柳站的颜色

dejaVu.zh: 「站务员，这个姿势……我是不是画过你？」
dejaVu.en: "Attendant, this pose... have I drawn you before?"

awayVoice.zh: 「今天画了二十五块。你不在，没人挡路。」
awayVoice.en: "Twenty-five tiles today. You weren't here; no one kept the way clear."

habits.zh: 用头灯闪一下代替打招呼
habits.en: flashes his headlamp instead of saying hi

contradiction.zh: 把别人的墙补了八年，却觉得拿走自己的砖是件坏事
contradiction.en: mended someone else's wall for eight years, yet feels taking back his own tiles is wrong

growth.zh: 从一个人夜里补墙，到开口请人帮忙
growth.en: from mending the wall alone at night to asking for help

style.zh: 写在检修日志的空白处：日期、里程、换了什么，偶尔画一块砖
style.en: in the margins of the maintenance log: date, chainage, what was replaced, now and then a drawing of a tile

seesMe.en: Little Tang, the one who steps on rails

seesMe.zh: 他拿着那块砖没告诉站长
seesMe.en: he kept that tile and didn't tell the station master
not bad; with him here, not bad

dejaVu.zh: 「嗯……枕木中间。你好像本来就知道。」
dejaVu.en: "Mm... between the sleepers. Seems you already knew."

awayVoice.zh: 「隧道里口哨响了。要下雨。你人呢。」
awayVoice.en: "The tunnel's whistling. Rain coming. Where are you."

habits.en: leaves things on the desk and walks off
